# Deputable AI website

Static marketing site for deputable.ai — plain HTML/CSS/JS, no framework, no build step.
Deployed via GitHub Pages from the repo root (custom domain in `CNAME`, `.nojekyll` present).

## How this repo works — IMPORTANT

**Do not hand-edit the six page HTML files.** They are generated by `scripts/generate_site.py`,
which holds the shared header/footer/nav and all page content in one place.

To change anything:

1. Edit `scripts/generate_site.py` (content, nav, structure) and/or `css/style.css` / `js/main.js` (styling, behaviour).
2. Regenerate: `python3 scripts/generate_site.py` (writes the HTML files to the repo root).
3. Preview: `python3 -m http.server 8000` from the repo root.

Generated pages: `index.html`, `services.html`, `how-it-works.html`, `about.html`, `trust.html`, `contact.html`.
Hand-maintained: `css/style.css`, `js/main.js`, `assets/deputable-logo.png`, `CNAME`, `.nojekyll`, `README.md`.

Favicons and the social share image (`assets/favicon.ico`, `favicon-32.png`, `apple-touch-icon.png`,
`og-image.png`) are derived from the logo by `scripts/generate_icons.py` — rerun it if the logo changes.

## Notes and pending items

- The contact form (`contact.html` + `js/main.js`) is front-end only — shows a confirmation, sends nothing.
  Wire to Formspree or similar before relying on it.
- Placeholders remaining: founder portraits (about); founder bios are drafts;
  Trust & Security answers need sign-off before being treated as final.
- The interactive workflow demo on `services.html` is driven by `FLOW_MODES` in `js/main.js`.
- Repo is public (GitHub Pages): never commit secrets, keys, or the `_to_delete/` and `.idea/` folders
  (both gitignored).

## Brand/style quick reference

Fonts: Schibsted Grotesk (body/headings), IBM Plex Mono (eyebrows/labels).
Core colours: navy `#0E2A4A`, ink `#0B1A2B`, teal `#16BFA0`, blue `#00B4FF`, background `#FBFBF9`.
Tone: plain-spoken, UK English, human-centric — AI assists and a person stays accountable; avoid
hype language that would put off AI-averse SME owners.
